captions.detailed: This 3D model features a closed-loop chain composed of interlocking, stylized heart-shaped links. Each link has a smooth, flat-sided thickness, with one half of the heart lying flat in the horizontal plane and the other half curving upwards to loop through the adjacent link. The interlocking design creates a continuous, flexible-looking bracelet or necklace structure.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric heart-shaped chain script in OpenSCAD that can generate either a straight chain or a closed-loop bracelet. The user should be able to adjust the number of links, the thickness of the links, and choose whether to render all links together, or only the even/odd links for dual-color extrusion.
captions.factory: The design defines a custom 'HEARTHALF' module using a flat 2D polygon extruded via linear_extrude. The 'HEARTS' module joins two scaled and rotated halves (one flat, one angled) using union, then trims the bottom and center using difference with cube primitives to create a clean interlocking link. The chain is constructed with a for-loop in either 'StraightChain' or 'LoopChain' modules, where odd and even links are translated, mirrored, or rotated along a circular path of calculated radius based on the link count.
